name: Beef chilli con carne
steps: Soften the chopped onion in the olive oil until translucent.
Add the ground beef and brown it well, breaking up any clumps.
Stir in cumin and a pinch of salt, then pour in the tinned tomatoes.
Add the kidney beans and a splash of water and bring to a simmer.
Cook gently for 20 minutes until thickened and rich.
Taste, adjust the seasoning, and serve.
